lines.zh: 我的脚不着地，风托着我走。
lines.en: My feet do not touch down; the wind carries me.

lines.zh: 翅膀一振，我就往前滑一截。
lines.en: One wingbeat and I slide forward.

lines.zh: 我飞在山脊上方，看着下面。
lines.en: I fly above the ridge, watching below.

lines.zh: 我落下来的时候，只停一下就起。
lines.en: When I land, I stay only a moment.

lines.zh: 我贴着崖壁飞，翼尖几乎擦过石。
lines.en: I fly along the cliff, wingtips nearly on stone.
I need no road. The sky is the road.
I am faster than I look.

lines.zh: 我从恶地的红岩上方掠过。
lines.en: I skim over the red rock of the badlands.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴在空中修正方向。
lines.en: My tail corrects direction in the air.

lines.zh: 我绕着一个锚点飞，不离太远。
lines.en: I circle an anchor point, never far.

lines.zh: 上坡时我借风，下坡时我加速。
lines.en: I ride the wind up, and speed down.

lines.zh: 我在山峰之间穿来穿去。
lines.en: I weave between the peaks.

lines.zh: 我的影子扫过一片山毛榉。
lines.en: My shadow sweeps over a stand of beeches.

lines.zh: 我扇两下翅膀，就越过一道沟。
lines.en: Two beats carry me across a ravine.

lines.zh: 我悬停着，翅膀扇得很快。
lines.en: I hover, wings beating fast.
From up here everything is small.

lines.zh: 我的头盔一样的头，很轻。
lines.en: My helm-like head is light.

lines.zh: 我在听风里有没有别人的声音。
lines.en: I listen for others in the wind.
This body is a perfect form.

lines.zh: 我不需要落地就能休息。
lines.en: I can rest without landing.
There is hard bone at my wing edges.

lines.zh: 我在山头绕圈，一圈一圈。
lines.en: I circle the peak, round after round.
I look down at my own claws.
The thinner the air, the better I feel.

lines.zh: 我张了张嘴，风就灌进来。
lines.en: I open my mouth and the wind pours in.

lines.zh: 我在山脊上悬着，看你怎么动。
lines.en: I hover over the ridge, watching what you do.
My shadow never stops moving.

lines.zh: 我在锚点附近转了很久。
lines.en: I have circled the anchor a long while.

lines.zh: 抬头看，我的翼尖在你眼前。
lines.en: Look up; my wingtip is right before you.

lines.zh: 我低头看你，风把我托着。
lines.en: I look down at you, held by the wind.
Do you mean to fight me?
I can handle you alone.
One step of yours, ten beats of my wings.

lines.zh: 我不知道你为什么站在这里。
lines.en: I do not know why you stand there.
Your weapon is too short.

lines.zh: 我沿你的头顶画了个圆。
lines.en: I trace a circle over your head.
You should not look up for so long.

lines.zh: 我从下面来的时候，你看不见。
lines.en: When I come from below, you will not see me.

lines.zh: 你站的那块石头，我记着。
lines.en: The stone you stand on: noted.
I come down to face you directly.
You moved back; that's better.
My master is not here.
So I decide for myself.
This body was trained into being.
I veered, then corrected.

lines.zh: 左翼擦破一点，扇起来发响。
lines.en: A scrape on my left wing; it whistles as I beat.

lines.zh: 我从空中掉下一点高度。
lines.en: I lose a little altitude.
Still bleeding, and I still climb.

lines.zh: 我在空中被打得偏了线。
lines.en: I am knocked off my line in midair.
My bones are light and hard.

lines.zh: 这一下打偏我，我歪着飞。
lines.en: That one knocked me askew; I fly crooked.

lines.zh: 痛也只是收紧翼骨，不吭声。
lines.en: I only tighten my wing bones; no cry.
I climb back under the clouds.

lines.zh: 翅膀伤了一边，我还能扇。
lines.en: One wing is hurt; I can still beat it.
I eat meat, but not that.
You hold it up, standing low.
That scrap is not worth a landing.
I will come down and look.
Set it flat; don't raise it or I won't dive.
I do not snatch from people.
Not worth one beat of my wings.
Fresh blood on the wind.
Step back three paces first.

lines.zh: 我落地的风会把它吹走。
lines.en: The wind of my landing will blow it away.

lines.zh: 高空的风就够我撑很久。
lines.en: The high wind keeps me going a long while.

lines.zh: 这点东西，不值得我落一次。
lines.en: Not worth one landing.

lines.zh: 你撞在我翅膀上，直接被弹开。
lines.en: You hit my wing and were thrown clear.
I hit you and my line doesn't change.
Move; I cannot land here.
My wing edges are hard.
The wind of it pushed you away.

lines.zh: 翼风掀了你的帽子，我没停。
lines.en: My wake takes your hat; I don't slow.
I had to come low to hit you.

lines.zh: 让开那块石头，我要落地。
lines.en: Clear that stone; I'm coming down.
My claws only grazed you.
I climb back up.

lines.zh: 我是完成体，很少见同类。
lines.en: I am a perfect form. Kin are rare.
I do not much care for that.
My time goes into flying.
My kind are higher up, not here.
Such words mean nothing up here.

lines.zh: 我还没找到值得的对手。
lines.en: I have not found a worthy opponent yet.
Wait until this fight is over.
The wind will carry those words off.

lines.zh: 高处风大，这些话留不住。
lines.en: The wind up here carries such words away.
I am taking off now.

lines.zh: 我落下来，抓起一块石头。
lines.en: I drop down and grab a stone.
I hold it in my claws.
I have just learned this weight.
I throw it up.
I catch it again.
Iron smell rises from the crack.

lines.zh: 爪子一松，它掉进山谷里。
lines.en: My claws open and it drops into the valley.
Just a stone; I kick it off the cliff.
I carry it a short flight.
It fell. I did not go back.
You are below me.

lines.zh: 我贴着山脊滑下去，不出声。
lines.en: I glide down along the ridge without a sound.

lines.zh: 太阳在你背后，我从光里来。
lines.en: The sun is behind you; I come out of the glare.
I have your shoulder.

lines.zh: 我爬高，从你看不见的死角下。
lines.en: I climb and drop from your blind spot.
The wind is with me.
Your head came up too slowly.

lines.zh: 风把我的速度又推了一截。
lines.en: The wind shoves my speed up another notch.

lines.zh: 两翼并拢，我变成一支箭。
lines.en: Wings drawn in, I become an arrow.

lines.zh: 这一击，是 V 字箭。
lines.en: This is the V-Arrow.
You are beneath me now.

lines.zh: 翅膀已经收好，冲角对准你。
lines.en: Wings tucked, my line of attack fixed on you.
I circle you in the air.
You turn; I change angle.
I wait for a gap.
Holding that weapon will tire you.
I come from the other side.

lines.zh: 风里有我的翼声，越来越近。
lines.en: My wingbeat rides the wind, closer now.

lines.zh: 我压低，影子就罩住你的脸。
lines.en: I drop low and my shadow covers your face.
I stay a little above you.

lines.zh: 崖边没有路，你再退就掉。
lines.en: No path at the cliff edge; one more step and you fall.
I rise from below.
You look back; I am already up.

lines.zh: 我再绕半圈，找到你的侧背。
lines.en: Half a circle more, and I'll have your flank.
I dive and rake once.
My claws pass over your shoulder.

lines.zh: 我一爪劈下，风先到，爪后到。
lines.en: I slash down; the wind arrives before my claws.

lines.zh: 我用 V 字箭打你。
lines.en: I hit you with the V-Arrow.

lines.zh: 风压把你顶退，鞋底在蹭地。
lines.en: The pressure shoves you back, boots scraping.
I close, then break away at once.
A light pass, just enough to warn you.

lines.zh: 我的速度比你的反应快。
lines.en: I am faster than your reactions.

lines.zh: 抬盾挡住了，可第二下来自上面。
lines.en: Your shield stops the first; the second comes from above.
The second comes from above.

lines.zh: 爪子落下，铁片上多了个坑。
lines.en: My claws land and leave a dent in the plate.
I give half a step and rise again.

lines.zh: 我从高空落下来，风把草压平。
lines.en: I drop from high above; the wind flattens the grass.

lines.zh: 我第一次振翅，就离地了。
lines.en: My first wingbeat lifts me.

lines.zh: 一振翅，整座山都在下面。
lines.en: One beat and the whole mountain is below me.
I hover above the ridge.
Everything below is small.
I remember an anchor point.

lines.zh: 锚点在北边，我顺着气流去。
lines.en: The anchor lies north; I ride the current there.
Wind passes under my wings.
I try a burst of speed. Fast.
So this is a perfect form.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴自己会修正方向。
lines.en: My tail corrects direction on its own.
I fly toward the nearest peak.
Humans are moving below.

lines.zh: 先绕三圈，看清下面再落。
lines.en: Three circles first; then I'll come down.

lines.zh: 火燎过我的翼膜，我赶紧抬升。
lines.en: Fire grazes my membrane; I climb fast.

lines.zh: 翼来不及张，我砸出一个坑。
lines.en: Wings too slow to open; I make a crater.

lines.zh: 水让我飞不起来，我往下沉。
lines.en: Water grounds me and I sink.

lines.zh: 爆风掀我翻了个身，我抓住气流。
lines.en: The blast flips me over; I catch the air current.
There is a small hole in my membrane.

lines.zh: 咒力缠上来，我的翅膀变沉。
lines.en: A curse wraps me and my wings grow heavy.
Too hungry to beat my wings.

lines.zh: 雷从云里下来，打在我背上。
lines.en: Lightning comes out of the cloud onto my back.

lines.zh: 下面没有地，我一直往下坠。
lines.en: No ground below; I keep falling.
